2: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
3: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
4: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
5: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
6: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
7: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
8: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
9: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
10: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
11: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
12: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
